subject_group: 6.2.14 Vehicle control function engage, disengage, and interlocks safety

versions.text:
Standard: Vehicle control function provides protection from rapid mode transitions that can adversely affect controllability of the air vehicle. Vehicle control function logic that retains, adjusts, or initializes values following a mode transition or sequences of mode transitions do not lead to loss of control. The VCF provides notification to the flight crew regarding mode engagement or disengagement. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review technical documentation regarding methods of mode engagement and disengagement.
(2) Review technical documentation regarding VCF logic following mode transition. Analysis.
  (1) Complete FMECA and SSHA to identify failure cases and associated mode engagement or disengagement. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct 6-DOF simulation to verify correct response to rapid mode transition requests to include oscillating between modes.
    (2) Lab test: Conduct 6-DOF simulation to verify VCF logic during mode transitions, to include sequential mode transitions or oscillating between modes, does not cause loss of control.
    (3) Lab test: Conduct PITL simulation to verify flight crew notification for mode engagement or disengagement.
    (4) Lab test: Conduct PITL simulation to verify operational state following engagement, disengagement, and transition between modes in normal conditions and due to failures. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
      (1) Conduct flight test operations evaluating mode transition transient behavior.
